source_material: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT06110234 as described in the report and public registry mirrors

study_assessment.notes: Custom study-level appraisal used because RoB 2 is correctly result-specific rather than a paper-level quality score. Scope: design/conduct/reporting adequacy required to support the result-specific RoB 2 appraisal. Judgement vocabulary: strong, minor_concern, major_concern, insufficient_information. This is not a validated external quality score and does not replace result-specific RoB 2.

domains.domain_label: Design and randomization documentation
domains.supporting_text: Independent team member generated blocked allocation; recruitment and assessment staff were separated from assignment; baseline characteristics showed no material imbalance.

domains.domain_label: Masking and assessment separation
domains.supporting_text: Recruitment/assessment staff were blinded to assignment and participants were blinded to which memory-training condition was the active comparator.

domains.domain_label: Participant flow and post-randomization loss
domains.supporting_text: 54 participants were randomized and 51 analysed; all three post-randomization losses occurred in SPECTRA, including one withdrawal after one session for lack of motivation.

domains.domain_label: Outcome measurement documentation
domains.supporting_text: Programmed/standardized outcome procedures, distinct pre/post materials and defined scoring procedures were reported for the current behavioral outcomes.

domains.domain_label: Analysis, registration and transparency
domains.supporting_text: Trial registration, preregistration statement, open data/code/materials and analysis descriptions are reported, but the preserved preregistered analysis specification has not yet been compared line-by-line with the reported mixed-model/model-selection procedure.

result_assessments.estimand_or_result_scope: Effect of assignment to SPECTRA versus ASSO on post-intervention free recall.
result_assessments.notes: RoB 2 appraisal candidate based on the full report and available registration/transparency information. Domain 3 is some concerns because all three missing randomized participants were from SPECTRA and one withdrew after exposure for lack of motivation. Domain 5 remains some concerns because the exact preregistered analysis specification was not directly compared with the reported model-selection procedure.

domains.domain_label: Bias arising from the randomization process
domains.supporting_text: Independent blocked randomization, restricted allocation access, blinded recruitment/assessment and no material baseline imbalance were reported.

domains.domain_label: Bias due to deviations from intended interventions
domains.supporting_text: Matched six-session structures and participant blinding were reported; no systematic crossover or contamination affecting the effect-of-assignment comparison was identified.

domains.domain_label: Bias due to missing outcome data
domains.supporting_text: 54 randomized, 51 analysed; all three losses were from SPECTRA and one withdrew after one session for lack of motivation. No sensitivity analysis resolving the missing outcomes was identified.

domains.domain_label: Bias in measurement of the outcome
domains.supporting_text: Assessment staff were blinded and free-recall procedures/scoring were standardized; no differential measurement by randomized arm was identified.

domains.domain_label: Bias in selection of the reported result
domains.supporting_text: Prospective registration and open-science statements reduce concern, but direct comparison of the preregistered analysis specification with reported mixed-model/model-selection choices remains unresolved.

result_assessments.estimand_or_result_scope: Effect of assignment to SPECTRA versus ASSO on post-intervention spatial recognition.
result_assessments.notes: Same trial-level RoB structure as the other post-intervention outcomes; outcome-measurement evidence is specific to programmed spatial-recognition performance.
